prompt.text:
Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Return solution.js and expose the function as a CommonJS export.
Required API: exports.clampWindow = function(start, size, length), using safe integers and returning [start,end] or null on failure
Behavior: Reject negative size or length. Clamp start into the inclusive range from zero to length, then return the half-open window ending at the smaller of start plus size and length, without arithmetic overflow.
Visible example: With start -2, size 3, and length 10, signed APIs return the window [0,3]; with start beyond length, return the empty window at length.

Buggy source to repair:

exports.clampWindow=function(s,n,len){if(n<0||len<0)return null;return[s,Math.min(s+n,len)]}

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
